slides.label: Verse 1
lines: Rhapsody Of Realities 8 March 2026 By Pastor Chris Oyakhilome (Christ Embassy): TOPIC: A Life Of Blessings, Glory, And Excellence

slides.label: Verse 2
lines: But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a dedicated nation,  own purchased, special people, that you may set forth the wonderful deeds and display the virtues and perfections of Him Who called you out of darkness into His marvelous light (1 Peter 2:9 AMPC).Books & Literature

slides.label: Verse 3
lines: Rhapsody Of Realities For Today’s MESSAGE:

slides.label: Verse 4
lines: As a Christian, you’re not subject to disease, infirmities or demons, because you have the transcendent life in Christ. You’re not in bondage to the elements of this world; you live above them. I love the way the Apostle Peter puts it; he said,

slides.label: Verse 5
lines: “Whereby are given unto us exceeding great and precious promises: that by these ye might be partakers of the divine nature, having escaped the corruption that is in the world through lust” (2 Peter 1:4).

slides.label: Verse 6
lines: You live far above and beyond the corruption, decadence and darkness of this world because you’re an associate of the God-kind, a partaker of the divine nature. You’re superior to Satan and the corrupting influences of this present world of darkness.

slides.label: Verse 7
lines: Your life is full of blessings, glory and virtue. Virtue is excellence; you have an excellent life in Christ Jesus.Motivational speeches

slides.label: Verse 8
lines: Think about the Apostle Peter who wrote the beautiful verses of scripture that we read earlier; he once trembled with fear and denied the Lord Jesus before a little girl.

slides.label: Verse 9
lines: His faith was unstable. But after he received the Holy Spirit, something changed. He expressed and manifested the God-life in Him with such glory and boldness that through his preaching, three thousand souls gave their hearts to Christ in one day, as revealed in Acts 2:41.

slides.label: Verse 10
lines: What transformed him? He had come to the revelation of the glorious life we have in Christ. What a life! There’s no failure, defeat, or darkness in you; only blessings, excellence, perfection, and glory.

slides.label: Verse 11
lines: 1 Peter 3:9 says you were called to inherit a blessing, not shame or weakness. This is the life you’ve received in Christ; it’s one of dominion over sickness, disease, demons, poverty, failure and death. Glory to God!

slides.label: Verse 13
lines: I thank you Father for the glorious life you’ve given me in Christ Jesus, a life of blessings, excellence, health, victory and strength. I walk in your marvellous light, displaying your virtues and perfections to my world.

slides.label: Verse 14
lines: I live above sickness, defeat and demonic influence because I live in Christ. Hallelujah!
